evidence.claim: OutputFormat is a closed enum (text, json, stream-json) and the JSON stream taxonomy (init, message, tool_use, tool_result, error, result) is centralized in types.ts; no advisor/escalation event type exists.
JsonFormatter.format builds JsonOutput with optional session_id, ANSI-stripped response, stats, and error, then JSON.stringify(..., null, 2); formatError reuses the same path.
StreamJsonFormatter writes one minified JSON object plus newline per event; ordering is enforced by callers.
Legacy and agent-session non-interactive drivers emit the same JSONL contract from two different upstream event unions (GeminiEventType vs AgentEvent).

ACP Session.prompt accepts / and $ as command prefixes and routes through the ACP-only CommandHandler registry (Memory, Extensions, Init, Restore, About, Help), not the interactive CommandService loader chain.
Non-output agent events (session_update, custom, etc.) are explicitly ignored by the agent-session non-interactive driver.

contradictions.description: Spec implies a single non-interactive output path, but two parallel drivers (legacy and agent-session) translate distinct event unions to the same JSONL contract.
ACP command surface uses a narrow ACP-only registry; CLI non-interactive uses BuiltinCommandLoader+McpPromptLoader+FileCommandLoader. /pollux reachability differs by transport.

risks.description: Adding a Pollux advisor-escalation event requires coordinated change to JsonStreamEventType and both non-interactive drivers; absent that, escalations are dropped silently.
risks.suggestedGuard: assert each new event type round-trips through integration-tests/json-output.test.ts

risks.description: ACP tool/permission requests use connection.requestPermission, not the policy engine; a synthetic advisor tool may produce an unexpected permission prompt.
risks.suggestedGuard: classify advisor as non-prompting in policy engine

risks.description: Agent-session non-interactive driver silently ignores unrecognized AgentEvent types; future Pollux events on 'custom' will be invisible.
risks.suggestedGuard: add switch-exhaustiveness check or unknown-event warning

risks.description: StreamJsonFormatter performs no sequencing; out-of-order callers can produce a malformed stream.
risks.suggestedGuard: keep Pollux interceptor strictly upstream of formatter calls

gaps: No event-type for advisor/escalation in JsonStreamEventType (R-12.1, R-12.3).
No regression assertion that both non-interactive drivers emit identical JSONL for equivalent input (C-12.1).
ACP advisor permission flow not exercised (R-12.2).

openQuestions: OQ-12.1: Should advisor_consultation invocations surface as tool_use/tool_result or a new event kind? Escalate to 02 and 04.
OQ-12.2: Does ACP need parallel /pollux registration, or only via prompt text? Escalate to 13.
